endgame_notes: In the PVP instance of the Deep Desert, mining yields and spice harvesting is increased by 250%.
On Single Player, the Deep Desert does not reset with the Coriolis Storm, therefore this map remains static week to week.
Row A (Mk5) loot tables are at the bottom (collapsed).
The loot tables below contain all of the Unique Schematics that are available from the Deep Desert each week.
Updated shortly after the reset each week.
Try switching the map view from Normal to Detailed for more filters (including crashed ships and all resources) and much more granular resource density on zoom.
